Data issues found:

A normalize_labels fix was proposed to merge them into the allowed labels (Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo) but was rejected by the user, so the data was left as-is. The analysis above uses only rows with species exactly "Adelie" (11 rows); the misspelled "adelie" and "Adeile" rows were not included.
- flipper_length_mm has one out-of-range value (-200) at row 36, but this column is not used by the question.
- No missing values in bill_length_mm; no duplicates.
